title: Jagged Mexican Pork Tamales
description: A twist on traditional tamales, filled with shredded pork, wrapped in a flavorful corn masa and steamed to perfection.
instructions: Shred pork shoulder and set aside.
Char jagged pepper and onion over an open flame until tender.
Mince garlic and sauté with cumin, chili powder and salt.
Combine pork, pepper, onion and garlic mixture.
Mix corn masa with water and knead until pliable.
Shape masa into a ball and flatten into a disk.
Place 1/4 cup of pork mixture in the center of the masa.
Fold masa into a triangle and press edges together.
Repeat with remaining masa and filling.
Steam tamales for 45-60 minutes or until masa is tender.
Serve with chopped cilantro and your favorite toppings.
